purpose: Initialized pre-starter save positioned below the bedroom TV

start.progression: New Game initialized; starter not chosen

creation_procedure: Boot crystallegends.gbc in PyBoy 2.6.0 with an empty battery save.
Choose New Game, Boy, the default 10:00 clock, and the preset name CHRIS.
Complete Professor Oak's introduction without changing gameplay state.
Walk from the bedroom spawn at (3,3) to (4,2) and face up.
Use the in-game Start menu Save command and accept the confirmation.
Persist PyBoy battery RAM only after _SaveGameData and SavedTheGame execute.
